items.b: INDIA'S GOLD IMPORTS FALL 45% TO US$2.3BN AS ETFS REACH 121.3T
items.t: Domestic prices traded below import parity through August, with discounts widening from US$34 an ounce in July to US$51. Indian gold ETFs took INR25.97bn, an inflow up 67% on the month.

items.b: GOLD FALLS $14.50 TO $4,333.70 WITH ALL FOUR METALS LOWER
items.t: Silver gave up 0.92% to $65.521 and palladium 0.78% to $1,272.00 against Monday's marks on Kitco's bid. Gold's overnight range ran from $4,290.70 to $4,376.90.

items.b: RAPI RESTATES ALL FIVE DAILY POINTS READ A DAY EARLIER
items.t: The one-carat series read on 21 September and again on 22 September differs at every overlapping date, by between 12 and 27 cents. The newest point, dated 21 September, is $3,918.53.

items.b: THAILAND'S GOLD EXPORTS FALL 59.22% IN JULY TO US$411.04M
items.t: Gem and jewellery exports excluding gold slipped 6.36% to US$737.93m. Seven-month exports excluding gold still run 9.87% ahead at US$8,981.12m.

items.b: RAPI'S 1-CARAT ROSE TO $3,916.19 ACROSS FIVE SESSIONS
items.t: Corrected 22 September 2026. The index published a new point on each of 17, 18, 19 and 20 September; an earlier version of this item reported it as unchanged since the 16th.
